question.text: An 'Accredited Investor' framework (introduced by SEBI) offers:

answer.text: Flexibility in minimum investment amount and concessions from certain regulatory requirements

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's Accredited Investor framework allows flexibility in minimum investment (Rs. 1 crore waiver for AIs) and regulatory concessions. The Trap: Other claims don't match the framework. Cross-Exam Context: Tested in Topic 2 and others. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Help qualifying clients obtain Accredited Investor certification to access LVF structures.
